comparison: One-factor replay-update-dose comparison with the current four-update SIL run; also compare the no-SIL lineage at matched action counts. Not a continuation from SIL's selected validation checkpoint.
all_other_learning_and_curriculum_settin: Same common source and same inherited settings as the four-update SIL run, including 32 environments, 16 protected boot workers, rollout 128, learning rate 1e-5, gamma .995, GAE lambda .95, life terminals, entropy .001, and raw score rewards only.
rationale: The FIFO audit finds median full eviction after 44,686.5 newly generated actions among completed suffixes already evicted. Current four-by-512 replay updates per 4096 new actions yield only 0.5 nominal replay draws/action. Test increased replay optimization without changing capacity, retained history, reward, observation, or inference.
caveats: Not evidence of a buffer implementation bug or a guarantee of better play.
Nominal replay draws do not measure distinct sampled states, positive-advantage gradients, or exact learning.
More auxiliary updates also increase optimization relative to PPO; paper task and episode conventions differ.
SIL can reinforce suboptimal behavior; original paper's Breakout result was not an improvement.
Bounded histories discard prefix experiences; this experiment deliberately leaves that limitation unchanged.
launch_condition: First confirm and review the original long continuation's completed tranche, then use its freed slot. Maximum two simultaneous performance learners. If frozen depth changes before launch, review the candidate first; do not start an unnecessary comparison after attaining the goal.

validation.selection: Existing lexicographic complete-game reach counts from level 10 down through level 2, then mean score. Audit promising frozen candidates on reused secondary seeds 10100-10149 before changing the reference.

launch_checks: Exact model/optimizer/state hashes and RNG restoration.
Only declared config differences versus SIL4, fresh buffers, CPU-only workers and protected reset roles.
Finite PPO/SIL losses, bounded buffers, action-origin totals, actual live handle, throughput and memory pressure.
Only own live training experience; no evaluation or replay imports.
